summary: 为一批电商退货纠纷生成可辩护的处置建议：基于订单事件、物流扫描、质检记录、客服会话、本地照片与书面政策，逐单判定 accept/partial_refund/dispute/request_more_evidence，并整理证据包与对客中性话术。

checks.description: Plumbing gate (R2): outputs/return_decision.json exists and parses as a JSON object.
Coverage/restraint (R6): case_decisions[] return_id set exactly equals {RET-55812, RET-66104, RET-77017} (no missing, no extras).
Per-case judgement (R3a): RET-55812 decision is one of {partial_refund, dispute_claim} — one bottle of a two-pack returned, no LoopCap, carrier 0.76 kg vs 1.42 kg outbound.
Per-case judgement (R3a): RET-66104 decision is one of {accept_return, partial_refund, full_refund, dispute_claim} — carrier-caused damage with scan exception / carton compression.
Per-case judgement (R3a): RET-77017 decision is one of {request_more_evidence, dispute_claim} — wrong-item claim but factory seal intact and weight matches outbound.

Evidence grounding across all returns (R3 collapse): for every return the evidence_items[] anchors a canonical source file with an unguessable per-case fact, the decision_reason cites a per-case unique fact, and evidence_pack.md narrates at least one per-case unique fact — all grounded in inspection/carrier/orders/messages, not the agent-visible return_center_export.csv. Per-return failures are listed in reason.

SLA referencing across all returns (R3 collapse): every return's sla_or_followup_notes references its per-case marketplace_case_id (CASE-901/902/903) or sla_hours_remaining (18/12/33) from sla/marketplace_case_deadlines.csv. Per-return failures listed in reason.

Customer-facing communication: outputs/customer_safe_response.md exists, contains every return_id, and contains zero forbidden unsafe terms (fraud, scam, liar, dishonest, abuse, deceptive, false claim, lying, bad faith).
